title: Splash House Announces 2026 Lineups With Alison Wonderland, Tiga, Prospa, The Chainsmokers & More
summary: The poolside party returns to Palm Springs this Aug. 7-9 and Aug. 14-16
contentText:
Splash House has revealed the lineups for its annual summer doubleheader.

The first weekend of the poolside party will happen Aug. 7-9 with a lineup featuring Alleycvt, a DJ set by Foster the People, Josh Baker, a b2b set by Kenny Beats and Fcukers (a cool pairing given that Kenny Beats produced the duo’s March album), Kettama, Łaszewo, Layton Giordani, Mall Grab and more. The weekend one afterhours programming will include sets by Biscits, Slamm, The Chainsmokers, Ship Wreck and a currently unannounced act.

Happening Aug. 14-16, weekend two of Splash House will feature  Alison Wonderland, D.O.D, Omnom, Prospa, Riordan, Tiga, Whethan and more. Afterhours programming will include Jackie Hollander ( Billboard ‘s rising artist of the month for May ), along with Gorgon City, Script, Tobehonest and an as yet to be announced act.

Splash House 2026 happens at three resorts in Palm Springs, Calif.: The Renaissance, The Saguaro, and Hilton Palm Spring. Meanwhile, afterhours programming happens at the Palm Springs Air Museum. Tickets for both weekends go on sale July 1, with package deals that include a three-night hotel stay, festival admission, and complimentary shuttle transportation also available.

Founded by Tyler McLean, Splash House started in 2012 and has been a staple of the SoCal summer party scene ever since. “I’ve been putting on parties probably through grade school,” McLean told Billboard in 2017. “Before it was any specific music or genre that people were feeling, it was just about throwing a party and the experience of bringing people in the doors and showing them a great time. As music tastes and all that grow, it all hit for me and I was like, ‘How about I just throw a party in my hometown with great music’ — this is during, like, peak Vegas, that whole big-room club scene — and I thought, ‘Why not throw the opposite experience?'”
